title: SSS death benefits climb to P63.7B in Jan-Sept

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Death benefits disbursed by the Social Security System (SSS) jumped to P63.74 billion in the first three quarters of the year, driven by the early implementation of a pension increase for surviving spouses or death pensioners in June. In a statement, the SSS said death benefit payouts through the end of September rose 10.4 percent to P57.74 billion, up from P52.35 billion in the same period last year.
